content.prompt: Copy each of the target diagrams below into your workbook. Add the fraction in the centre circle to each fraction in the second circle and write your answer in the outermost circle. One part of the first diagram has been done for you.

spec.description: Three concentric circles with six corresponding sectors in the middle and outer rings. Radial lines stop at the centre circle. A fraction-circle template cannot express the concentric calculation rings and supplied sector answer. Decorative blue outlines and centre shading are replaced by black unfilled geometry.
spec.mathematics: Centre operation 1/2 +. Middle ring clockwise from upper right: 1/4, 3/2, 1 1/4, 1/6, 4/5, 3/8.
spec.answerVisibility: Only the supplied outer answer 3/4 in the upper-right sector is visible; five outer sectors remain blank.

spec.description: Complete target retaining all givens and radial correspondence.
spec.mathematics: Outer answers clockwise from upper right: 3/4, 2, 1 3/4, 2/3, 1 3/10, 7/8.
spec.answerVisibility: All outer answers visible in answer editions only.
